name: ui-hci
description: Handbook-first UI skill + local RAG (HHS/GSA 2006). Copy the listed paths; do not inherit iPad bindings unless you want them.

license.handbook: U.S. government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105 public domain. Do not reuse HHS/GSA seals or logos.

bindingsDiscovery: Read packs/ui-hci/manifest.json and use the `bindings` filename (relative to this pack).
If `bindings` is missing or empty, use packs/ui-hci/bindings.json if that file exists.
Do not apply another repo’s overlay (e.g. bindings.ipad-cursor.json) unless this project chose it.
notes: Keep the PDF in the source repo; copy it only if you need figures or to rebuild RAG. Prebuilt ui-rag chunks are enough.
Vite in this repo ignores refs/**. Other tools should ignore refs/ the same way if they watch the tree.
iPad / Pencil / tldraw rules live only in bindings.ipad-cursor.json, not in the skill core.
